title: Evolving Language Models without Labels: Majority Drives Selection, Novelty Promotes Variation
abstract: arXiv:2509.15194v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can improve through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), but many settings lack reference answers or external verifiers. Label-free self-improvement instead constructs training signals from the model's own outputs. Because the same policy generates both the candidate responses and the signals derived from them, each update also changes the candidates available for future training, creating a self-reinforcing feedback loop. We identify a failure mode of this loop, which we call selection-induced diversity collapse: repeated self-selection can progressively narrow the candidate pool and make alternative correct solutions harder to sample. To address this problem, we propose EVOL-RL, which balances selection and variation. translated_title: 无需标签的语言模型进化：多数投票驱动选择，新颖性促进变异
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可以通过带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来提升，但在许多场景中缺乏参考答案或外部验证器。无标签自我改进则转而从模型自身的输出中构建训练信号。由于同一个策略既生成候选响应，又生成由这些响应导出的信号，每次更新都会改变未来训练可用的候选集，从而形成一个自我强化的反馈循环。我们识别了这一循环的一种失效模式，称之为“选择诱导的多样性坍缩”：反复的自我选择会逐渐缩小候选池，使得其他正确解更难被采样到。为解决这一问题，我们提出 EVOL-RL，在选择与变异之间取得平衡：多数投票提供稳定的选择信号，基于嵌入的新颖性度量则在相同选择状态的响应之间细化信用分配，熵正则化（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 EVOL-RL 方法，用多数投票提供稳定选择信号、基于嵌入的新颖性促进变异并辅以熵正则化，解决了无标签自我改进中“选择诱导的多样性坍缩”问题，使大语言模型在缺乏参考答案时也能持续进化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EVOL-RL, which balances selection and variation—using majority voting for stable selection, embedding-based novelty for variation, and entropy regularization—to prevent selection-induced diversity collapse and enable label-free self-improvement of LLMs.
